result.summary: Found 1 significant visual layout issue in the restaurant listing content.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata is overlapping: the delivery-time text (“25–30 min”) collides with the delivery/category row below it, making the information difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase vertical spacing or fix the metadata row layout so the delivery time and delivery/category details occupy separate, non-overlapping lines.
